name: Tsuyu Asui
source:
The student of class 1A, [url=https://vndb.org/c104176]Izuku[/url]'s classmate, [url=https://vndb.org/c104197]Ochako[/url]'s friend. The calm, sensible girl, she is a match for her quirk - frog metamorphosis (can do anything frogs can do). Values friendship and doesn't mind socializing with others, although won't initiate an acquaintance unless it's a rare occasion.
